A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GARDEN and provide readable main text, equations, Tables 1–5, Figures 1–11 and Appendices A–G. Citation renumbering and page reflow can be reconciled without material comparison gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction, gravity-estimation, ablation and runtime results in Tables 1–5, plus point-classification and robustness results in Appendix B.3.

after.justification: v2 retains original GARDEN experiments in Tables 1–5 and Appendix B.3, including gravity prediction and classification under clean and perturbed inputs.

M1.justification: The gravity-alignment predictor, SAM-3/SAM-3D object generation, FoundationPose refinement, conditional point classifier and physics-simulation pipeline remain unchanged, including their appendix specifications.

E1.justification: Training retains Hypersim, TartanAir, vKitti and InternScenes-Real2Sim. Evaluation retains the LiteReality benchmarks, gravity datasets, cross-dataset qualitative examples, tabletop captures and artifact-perturbation scenarios.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods: MIR, PhotoShape and LiteReality variants; Phone2Proc and ACDC variants; the five gravity baselines; and DA3/pose ablations. SAM-3D and DA3 qualitative comparisons also remain.

E3.justification: The static and 10-second MuJoCo evaluation protocols, five-scene Hypersim ablation, local point-cloud metrics, 20% InternScenes-ScanNet holdout and stated training/inference settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 4 retains the same gravity-alignment, pose and simulation ablations. Appendix B.3 retains the same clean-versus-artifact robustness evaluation; no diagnostic experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including the descriptive mean, P90 and failure-rate summaries. Neither version supplies repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5, Appendix B.3 and qualitative result panels retain the same outcomes. For example, GV mean errors remain 1.40 degrees on Hypersim and 1.56 degrees on TartanAir, and GARDEN's mean latency remains 560.2 seconds.

T1.justification: The GV coordinate construction, collinearity fallback, rotation loss in Equation 1 and appendix decoder/rotation equations are unchanged. No mathematical derivation, theorem or proof is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about RGB-only gravity-based factorization, CAD-free object reconstruction, simulation readiness and efficiency.

C2.justification: v2 deletes Section 4.3's discussion of reconstruction holes, gravity-alignment generalization under limited training diversity or weak structural cues, and proposed inpainting/joint-optimization remedies. Appendix G retains object-generation and pose-estimation limitations, so the removal is partial.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page link in the abstract. Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware and appendix instructions remain unchanged; the PDFs alone do not establish a new code or data release.

R1.justification: The same 57 works and substantive research positioning are retained. Alphabetization, citation renumbering, reference formatting and bibliographic metadata updates do not introduce different related work.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited grammar and typo corrections, adds author-role/affiliation details and acknowledgements, removes Section 4.3 and reformats the bibliography. The remaining narrative and appendix text are substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 2–3 are reduced in size, Figure 4's caption is corrected, and text/bibliography reflow changes page composition. All eleven figures and five tables retain their substantive visual content and organization.

improvement.justification: The project-page link and editorial corrections offer limited benefits, but deleting Section 4.3 removes useful qualifications about incomplete geometry and gravity-alignment generalization without evidence that these limitations were resolved. Appendix G preserves some failure discussion but does not replace those specific caveats. With the method and empirical evidence unchanged, this modestly reduces transparency about applicability.
